title: Citrus reticulata tea for medicinal use
intro: Citrus reticulata tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried peel of the mandarin orange, known for its aromatic and slightly sweet flavor. This tea is commonly used in herbalism to support digestion and relieve symptoms of nausea and bloating. It is also valued for its calming properties and is often consumed to reduce stress and promote relaxation. In traditional medicine, it is believed to aid in detoxification and improve liver function. Its high content of flavonoids and vitamin C contributes to its antioxidant and immune-boosting benefits.
